quarterly_data.quarter: MaxLinear press release: MaxLinear Expands AI Infrastructure Control-Plane Portfolio (08-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: MaxLinear launched two 16V high-current eFuse devices for AI infrastructure power protection and telemetry (AI servers, accelerator trays, data center switches, fan trays, power shelves, plug-in modules): the MxL745950 (16V, 50A, 1mOhm on-resistance, 5mm x 5mm LGA-32) and the stackable MxL745951P (16V, 60A, 0.79mOhm on-resistance, PMBus/I2C telemetry with +/-1% current monitoring accuracy, 5mm x 4.5mm VQFN-26L). Both are sampling now with volume production expected in Q4 2026. The release cites an industry estimate of the global eFuse market at approximately $1.0B today.
quarterly_data.figure: MxL745950 16V/50A; MxL745951P 16V/60A; sampling now, volume production expected in Q4 2026
